title: Caves of Qud weapon
description: Combat definition of a Caves of Qud weapon. Field names, types, and defaults are taken verbatim from the decompiled Part classes XRL.World.Parts.MeleeWeapon and XRL.World.Parts.MissileWeapon (see README.md for file:line provenance). A Qud weapon is a GameObject whose combat behavior lives in exactly one of these two Parts; 'name' here stands in for the GameObject's Render.DisplayName / blueprint id. NOTE: the decompile contains NO ObjectBlueprints XML, so the per-blueprint Render/Physics/Commerce values (glyph, weight, value) of named weapons are NOT represented here.

name.description: Display name / blueprint id of the weapon GameObject.

weaponType.description: Which weapon Part defines this object: MeleeWeapon or MissileWeapon.

BaseDamage.description: Base damage as a die expression (e.g. '2d3') or a flat integer string (e.g. '5', '1'). MeleeWeapon.cs:29.

Skill.description: Weapon-skill class governing proficiency/specials. Values observed in the decompile: 'Cudgel', 'ShortBlades', 'LongBlades'. MeleeWeapon.cs:33.

Stat.description: Attribute whose modifier feeds hit/damage. MeleeWeapon.cs:35.

Slot.description: Body-part slot the weapon occupies. MeleeWeapon.cs:37 (natural weapons override this to their attachment body part at runtime).

MaxStrengthBonus.description: Cap on the Strength-derived damage bonus. The sentinel 999 (MeleeWeapon.BONUS_CAP_UNLIMITED, MeleeWeapon.cs:21) means uncapped. MeleeWeapon.cs:23.

Ego.description: Ego contribution (used by some weapon behaviors). MeleeWeapon.cs:31.

Attributes.description: Space-separated attribute flags on the weapon. MeleeWeapon.cs:39.

Modifier.description: Attribute whose modifier feeds ranged accuracy. MissileWeapon.cs:57.

ShotsPerAction.description: Shots fired per use action. MissileWeapon.cs:27.

AmmoPerAction.description: Ammo consumed per use action. MissileWeapon.cs:29.

ShotsPerAnimation.description: Shots grouped per fire animation. MissileWeapon.cs:31.

AmmoChar.description: Glyph drawn for the projectile. MissileWeapon.cs:41.

ShowShotsPerAction.description: Whether the UI shows shots-per-action. MissileWeapon.cs:45.

FiresManually.description: Whether the player fires it manually. MissileWeapon.cs:47.

ProjectilePenetrationStat.description: Stat used for projectile penetration, if any. MissileWeapon.cs:49.
